messages:
Alex K.: Quick sync — I'm drafting the Operational Insights roadmap doc focused on dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, and error analytics. Need to agree launch criteria and customer-prioritization. Thoughts?
Maria P.: +1. Can we surface a lightweight rubric: customer impact, implementation effort, infra cost delta? keep it 3 buckets.
Jamal R.: For enterprise customers we need committed SLA metrics (p95 latency for dashboards, trace ingest durability). Those should be a hard blocker for Dedicated/Private launch.
Sophia G.: Agree re SLA. Also recommend we define two personas: Observability consumer (product engineers) and Platform owner (infra/platform teams). Different slice of features map to each.
Lee T.: Heads-up — trace ingest at high qps kills costs unless we sample. We need sampling knobs and clear sampling defaults and a plan for prefix/KV caching in runtime.
Alex K.: Good call. Proposal: MVP acceptance = dashboards with top-10 queries, trace hooks with configurable sampling, cost breakdown per-model+route, and basic error analytics (top-10 error signatures + links). Canary must pass perf checks.
Maria P.: Add measurable gates: dashboard query <500ms median, trace hook overhead <5ms added p50, cost dashboard shows daily delta vs baseline. If any fails, delay GA.
Jamal R.: For Dedicated customers, add capacity plan: reserve GPU pool for analytics ingest and a fallthrough cheap tier. If we can automatically fallback to aggregated mode under contention that's huge.
Sophia G.: Customer asks we've collected: ACME and BetaCorp want deep error regression alerts (signal when model error rate increases per prompt-set). Pipe these to hooks and Slack. Include eval set comparison as acceptance.
Lee T.: Also need GDPR/Pii redaction checklist for traces and error payloads. Default retention 7d for traces, configurable to 90d for enterprise with redaction and encryption.
Alex K.: Can we sketch rollout phases? Phase 1: internal beta (platform + product) with sampling defaults, basic dashboards. Phase 2: customer beta (ACME, BetaCorp) with advanced error analytics and rollout policy. Phase 3: GA with SLA & Dedicated support.
Maria P.: Timeline suggestion: 6 weeks Phase1, 4 weeks Phase2, 2 weeks GA prep. But implement risk: trace storage + query perf. Might need extra eng sprint.
Jamal R.: We should reserve an eng sprint for backend index optimization — tracing queries need inverted index for span tags. Otherwise dashboard queries blow up.
Sophia G.: On acceptance tests: add synthetic workload that simulates 100k req/day and injects error patterns to validate alerts + regression thresholds.
Lee T.: Operationally we need cost throttles and alerting: if ingest cost > X% projected, auto-throttle sampling, notify teams. Add runbook for oncall.
Alex K.: I'll update the doc with these gates and phases. Action items: Maria -> draft rubric and gates, Jamal -> capacity/fallback design, Sophia -> customer ask doc + eval sets, Lee -> security/retention checklist.
Maria P.: I'll push a short PR to the roadmap doc by EOD with the rubric table.
Jamal R.: I'll prototype fallback mode and share design in eng-runtime next Tues.
Sophia G.: I'll pull the evals from ACME/BetaCorp and add example alert thresholds.
Lee T.: I'll outline PII redaction + retention config and link to security approval checklist.
deploy-bot: Reminder: roadmap-doc v0.3 draft published to https://redwood.in/docs/ops-insights/roadmap-draft (view-only).
Alex K.: Thanks team — we'll review changes in Thurs sync. If anyone needs to escalate scope/cuts, ping me beforehand. :thumbsup:
